description: This file defines a WebSocket-based gateway communication layer for a larger application. It includes protocol definitions, classes, and methods for managing WebSocket sessions, connecting to a gateway, sending and receiving messages, handling reconnections, and managing authentication tokens. It appears to be a core component responsible for establishing and maintaining WebSocket channels for real-time communication within the app.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: A protocol defining WebSocket task operations such as resume, cancel, send, receive, and sendPing.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: A protocol for creating WebSocket tasks from URLs.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A struct wrapping an object conforming to WebSocketTasking, providing methods to control WebSocket tasks.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A struct wrapping an object conforming to WebSocketSessioning, providing a method to create WebSocket tasks.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: A struct containing options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, caps, commands, permissions, client ID, mode, display name, and device identity inclusion.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: An enum representing different sources of authentication tokens, such as device token, shared token, bootstrap token, password, or none.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: An actor class responsible for managing a WebSocket connection to the gateway, handling connection, reconnection, message sending/receiving, authentication, and heartbeat.

methods.name: authSource
methods.description: Returns the last used authentication source.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the WebSocket connection and cancels associated tasks.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection, with retries and error handling.

methods.name: startKeepalive
methods.description: Starts the heartbeat task to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: keepaliveLoop
methods.description: Sends periodic ping to maintain NAT/traversal state.

methods.name: sendConnect
methods.description: Sends a connect request over WebSocket with necessary authentication.

methods.name: selectConnectAuth
methods.description: Selects the appropriate authentication method based on current stored and explicit tokens.

methods.name: handleConnectResponse
methods.description: Processes the server's response to a connect request, manages tokens, and initiates tick handling.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming WebSocket message event.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway and awaits response.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to the gateway.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps low-level errors with context for better error reporting.

methods.name: connectOrThrow
methods.description: Ensures connection is active or throws an error.

methods.name: encodeRequest
methods.description: Encodes a request into data payload to send over WebSocket.

methods.name: failPending
methods.description: Fails all pending requests with an error.

methods.name: timeoutRequest
methods.description: Handles timeout for a pending request.
